specificTasks.text: Background Research: Reviewed relevant literature to inform project topic selection and the overall design of the dry-lab studies, with a focus on receptor–ligand recognition, structure-guided mutation exploration, and molecular simulation.

Conceptualization: Designed and refined the molecular docking workflow, including strategies for receptor comparison and exploratory mutation analysis. Took primary responsibility for the overall design of the molecular dynamics studies;

Investigation: Independently carried out the early molecular docking studies, including receptor comparisons and exploratory mutation analysis. Worked with Ruoxi Yang on the later docking calculations and molecular dynamics simulation system preparation;
Data Curation: Worked with Ruoxi Yang to organize docking results, interaction fingerprint (IFP) data, cross-receptor residue mappings, and residue annotations for comparative analysis.

Analysis: Developed analysis tools with Ruoxi Yang, compared docking scores, poses, and residue interactions, and jointly analyzed molecular dynamics trajectories for receptor and ligand motion and contact persistence.
Visualization: Produced docking-pose visualizations, residue-level IFP plots, and molecular dynamics figures, including root-mean-square deviation (RMSD) profiles and contact statistics.
Writing: Documented docking and molecular dynamics methods, results, and interpretations, and wrote and revised the Wiki Model page.
